name: hud_ui_save_load_delete_save_file
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::DeleteSaveFile deletes the named save after optional confirmation, clears the name input, refreshes the save list, and clamps the selected row.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x434fb0 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x434fb0 validates the empty-name and missing-file exits, SavedGames path formatting, optional zLoc/ShowMessageBox confirmation, remove call, game-name clear, RefreshSaveFileList call, entry-count clamp, and SetSelectedEntryIndex.
The native smoke verifies the non-confirmation delete path against real SavedGames files, including removal, refresh, input clearing, and selection clamping.
